1 campaign run carries 2 real capture cohorts

cases.name: real_full_capture_ready
cases.mechanics: real core partition + persistMetaRawSnapshot + real mappers + persistMetaEntityObservation; second identical sync coalesced onto the same run under a second real partition

cases.name: real_writer_delta_ready
cases.mechanics: the second capture changed one raw campaign budget, so the writer itself returned manifestKind='delta' over a logical scope of 2 with 1 changed and 1 physical state rows (1 campaign rows on the delta run); the unchanged member is reconstructed from the base run

cases.name: real_scope_exit_ready
cases.mechanics: the second capture omitted c_200 and a_20 entirely, so the writer recorded the exits and the manifest must enumerate exactly the surviving identities

cases.name: future_heartbeat_preserves_history
cases.mechanics: a heartbeat at 2026-09-01 advanced last_captured_at to 2026-09-01 12:06:00+03; the read at the earlier 2026-08-31 cutoff must still see the 2026-08-30 occurrence

cases.name: missing_partition_never_attests
cases.mechanics: the receipt names a partition id with no meta_sync_partitions row

cases.name: foreign_partition_never_attests
cases.mechanics: the receipt names a real partition belonging to another provider account

cases.name: extended_lane_partition_never_attests
cases.mechanics: the receipt names a real extended-lane creative_daily partition

cases.name: missing_snapshot_never_attests
cases.mechanics: the receipt carries no raw snapshot reference at all

cases.name: snapshot_partition_mismatch_never_attests
cases.mechanics: the raw snapshot was recorded under a different real partition

cases.name: snapshot_endpoint_mismatch_never_attests
cases.mechanics: the raw snapshot was recorded for ad_configs, not campaign_configs

cases.name: newer_failed_blocks_older_complete
cases.mechanics: one complete capture at 09:06, then a FAILED capture at 11:06 on the same endpoint; the older complete run is still present and readable

cases.name: newer_partial_blocks_older_complete
cases.mechanics: one complete capture at 09:06, then a PARTIAL capture at 11:06 on the same endpoint; the older complete run is still present and readable

cases.name: wrong_endpoint_named
cases.mechanics: the campaign capture recorded endpoint ad_configs; the receipt and the run both carry it, so nothing is filtered away and the cause is visible

cases.name: cohort_mismatch_across_syncs
cases.mechanics: campaign and ad-set receipts name two DIFFERENT real core partitions at the same capture clock

cases.name: explicit_tombstone_supersedes_manifest
cases.mechanics: persistMetaExplicitEntityTombstone wrote 1 row into meta_entity_tombstones after the manifest's own capture clock

cases.name: receipt_collision_refused
cases.mechanics: an exact retry left the receipt count at 2; a colliding occurrence with a different run, page count and row count was REFUSED: Observation receipt collision with a DIFFERENT occurrence: run_id e8849c8f-f1fb-4efb-95ac-837c5db7094a != c16b6464-e03a-

cases.name: true_tie_forward_insertion
cases.mechanics: two materially different campaign receipts at the EXACT same captured_at, inserted in forward physical order (partitions 8a696116-665d-4096-b9d2-da5d64044875 then e72353f4-58ae-4919-b253-f66841fa431a)

cases.name: true_tie_reversed_insertion
cases.mechanics: two materially different campaign receipts at the EXACT same captured_at, inserted in reversed physical order (partitions 159e4acf-6ad0-4032-8b4c-73edaff29a2f then 9fdb978b-7ebd-4357-b24e-3200da48d674)
